customer_id.meaning: primary id of the member profile (seed uuid or content hash); one profile per cooperative member

name.meaning: member name exactly as written on the signed membership application (a person, joint members, or the legal name of a business or organization)

member_type.meaning: legal form of the membership as recorded on the membership application; joint means spouses holding one membership together

member_number.meaning: seven-digit cooperative membership number printed on every bill and on the capital credit notice, kept with its leading zeros (e.g. 0418237)

phone_number.meaning: primary contact phone number on file, ten digits with no punctuation

email.meaning: primary email address on file, lower case

mailing_address.meaning: mailing address for bills and capital credit checks, as written on file; may differ from any service location

tax_id_last4.meaning: last four digits of the Social Security number (individual and joint members) or of the federal Employer Identification Number (organizations), as given on the membership application

membership_date.meaning: date the board accepted the membership application; the member's patronage and capital credit history starts on this date

deceased_date.meaning: date of death of an individual member as shown on the certified death certificate the cooperative has received; empty when no certified death certificate is on file

verification_id.meaning: primary id of the verification record (content hash of the customer id; one record per member, updated in place)

customer_id.meaning: member whose identity was checked (foreign key -> customers)

verified.meaning: whether the caller passed identity verification; once true it is never set back to false

verified_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()
verified_at.meaning: moment of the most recent verification attempt

handoff_id.meaning: primary id of the transfer-to-representative record (content hash of customer id and reason)

customer_id.meaning: member whose call was transferred (foreign key -> customers)

reason.meaning: reason for the transfer; closed set of exactly these two values

created_at.format: ISO timestamp, exactly as returned by ctx.now()

service_account_id.meaning: primary id of the service account (one metered service location held by one member)

customer_id.meaning: member holding the service account (foreign key -> customers)

values: Schedule FH Farm and Home Service
variant_name.meaning: rate schedule the account is billed on, written as the official schedule name

status.meaning: lifecycle state of the service account (see the Electric Service lifecycle)

account_number.meaning: account number of the location printed on the bill, format NN-NNNN-NNN (e.g. 21-4407-003)

service_address.meaning: service location street address, or rural route and legal description where no street address exists, exactly as on the service application

meter_number.meaning: serial number of the meter installed at the location

meter_type.meaning: capability of the installed meter: ami_remote_disconnect can be disconnected and reconnected remotely; ami_standard needs a crew; ami_demand_ct is a current-transformer demand meter that needs a crew

phase.meaning: service phase delivered to the location

transformer_kva.meaning: installed transformer capacity serving the location, in kVA

billing_cycle.meaning: billing cycle in which the meter is read and billed; cycle_1 reads on the 1st, cycle_2 on the 8th, cycle_3 on the 15th and cycle_4 on the 22nd of each month

connect_type.meaning: how the account was opened: newly built service, transfer of an already energized location into this member's name, or a member returning to a location after it was idle in no one's name

connect_date.meaning: date the location started billing for this member; empty while pending_connect

rate_effective_date.meaning: date the current rate schedule took effect on the account

account_balance.meaning: current amount owed on the account (sum of all charges minus payments and credits); positive = owed, negative = credit balance

disconnect_notice_date.meaning: issue date of the outstanding disconnect notice; empty when no notice is outstanding

disconnect_past_due_amount.meaning: past-due amount demanded by the outstanding disconnect notice; 0.00 when no notice is outstanding

disconnect_date.meaning: date the meter was disconnected for nonpayment; empty unless the account is disconnected_nonpay or was final billed from that state

idle_date.meaning: date a seasonal idle de-energized the meter; empty unless the account is idle

medical_certificate_expires.meaning: last day on which an accepted medical certificate protects the account from disconnection; empty when none has been accepted

cash_only_until.meaning: last day of cash-only payment status after repeated returned payments; empty when the account is not on cash-only status

final_date.meaning: date of the final meter read; empty while the account is open

charge_id.meaning: primary id of the bill line (content hash)

customer_id.meaning: member holding the account (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event family of the line, as declared in the Electric Service charter

billing_period.meaning: billing period (month whose meter read closes the period) the line belongs to

charge_component.meaning: which bill line, fee, program charge or credit this row is; credits always carry bill_credit

charge_date.meaning: bill date for usage and program lines; date incurred for fees and late charges; posting date for credits

kwh.meaning: kWh billed on energy and power cost adjustment lines; 0 on other lines

metered_kw.meaning: highest 15-minute demand metered in the period, on demand lines; 0.0 on other lines

billed_kw.meaning: billing demand after ratchet and power factor adjustment, on demand lines; 0.0 on other lines

amount.meaning: amount of the line, always positive; the event family (charge or bill_credit) gives the direction on the account balance

credit_reason.meaning: why a credit was posted; empty on every charge line

source_reference_id.meaning: reference of the single record the line comes from (returned payment, trouble report, meter test, late charge line, deposit ledger entry, capital credit ledger entry, prepay account, arrangement or area light rental; the service account itself for connect, transfer, reconnect and restore fees); empty on ordinary usage lines

payment_id.meaning: primary id of the payment, return or pledge (content hash)

customer_id.meaning: member holding the account (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, as declared in the Electric Service charter

payment_date.meaning: posting date of a payment or return; recording date of a pledge

payment_channel.meaning: channel a payment came through; empty on returns and pledges

amount.meaning: payment, returned or pledged amount, always positive

payment_reference.meaning: confirmation number, check number or agency pledge number exactly as issued; empty on returns

original_payment_id.meaning: for a return, the payment that came back unpaid (foreign key -> service_payments); empty otherwise

return_reason.meaning: bank or issuer reason for a return; empty otherwise

assistance_agency.meaning: agency that pledged or paid, for pledges and energy_assistance_agency payments; empty otherwise

trouble_report_id.meaning: primary id of the report, crew finding or meter test (content hash)

original_report_id.meaning: for a crew finding, the outage report it resolves (foreign key -> service_trouble_reports); empty otherwise

cause_finding.meaning: where the crew found the cause; empty on reports and meter tests

crew_dispatch_period.meaning: whether the crew was dispatched inside cooperative business hours on a business day or at any other time; empty on reports and meter tests

resolution_date.meaning: date the crew completed the call or the meter test was performed

meter_test_result.meaning: meter test result: within tolerance, fast (over-registering beyond tolerance) or slow (under-registering beyond tolerance); empty on other rows

meter_error_pct.meaning: registration error found by the test, positive when fast and negative when slow; empty on other rows

certificate_id.meaning: primary id of the certificate record (content hash)

service_account_id.meaning: service account the certificate protects (foreign key -> service_accounts)

customer_id.meaning: member holding the account (foreign key -> customers)

event_type.meaning: event family of the row, as declared in the Electric Service charter

received_date.meaning: date the cooperative received the signed certificate

certifying_practitioner.meaning: name and credential of the certifying practitioner exactly as written on the certificate

expires_date.meaning: last day the certificate protects the account from disconnection; empty when the certificate was not accepted

service_order_id.meaning: primary id of the member service order (content hash)

customer_id.meaning: member placing the order (foreign key -> customers)

service_account_id.meaning: service account the order concerns (foreign key -> service_accounts)

requested_date.meaning: effective date the member asked for

order_status.meaning: submitted = taken by the service desk; confirmed = the member confirmed it; completed = carried out in the field or billing system; cancelled = withdrawn by the member before completion

request_status.meaning: submitted = taken by the service desk; member_confirmed = the member signed or confirmed it; completed = carried out; withdrawn = the member withdrew it

rebill_reason.meaning: why the unbilled balance was billed back, on rebill entries; empty otherwise

allocation_year.meaning: patronage year allocated or retired; empty on payouts, voids and escheats

patronage_revenue.meaning: revenue billed in the class in the allocation year that an allocation is based on; empty on other entries

retirement_cycle.meaning: year of the board resolution or special retirement that a retirement, payable or payout belongs to; empty on allocations

gross_retired_amount.meaning: allocated amount retired, on payables; empty otherwise

check_number.meaning: capital credit check number exactly as printed, on check payouts and voids; empty otherwise

service_account_id.meaning: service account credited or offset, on bill credit and offset payouts (foreign key -> service_accounts); empty otherwise

death_certificate_on_file.meaning: whether the certified death certificate has been received, for estate requests

w9_on_file.meaning: whether the estate's IRS Form W-9 has been received, for estate requests

original_entry_id.meaning: the voided check payout to be reissued, for check reissues (foreign key -> capital_ledger); empty otherwise

board_approval_date.meaning: date of the board meeting that approved the request; empty until approved
